scope_limits: No network training, checkpoint deserialization, posterior generation, optimizer, clustering, agent trial, upstream generator or installation.
torchkbnufft is unavailable in the existing runtime; NUFFT forward fixtures and historical closure residuals were not replayed. Pure losses and preprocessing were replayed with existing CPU torch.
loss_history.npy is an object array and was not deserialized. Both .pt checkpoints and the task PDF are inventoried but not downloaded.
The README writes log-amplitude denominator V13*V24; source indices implement V14*V23 for the supplied station order. All 485 stored values reproduce the implemented convention.
The stored mean and std derive exactly from posterior_samples.npy (1024 images); posterior_samples_1024.npy is a different set and must not be silently substituted.

Source preprocessing changed prior flux versus retained fixtures. Its Fourier pulse matches retained fixtures, while generate_fixtures_safe.py omits the phase factor. Saved outputs are historical artifacts, not proof the pinned main script can regenerate them.
The live generic scorer checks one image, ignores uncertainty, and has no published evaluation/metrics.json thresholds. Its metrics differ from the task-native helper.
One supplied reference and spatial containment do not establish a calibrated astrophysical posterior; two clusters in a chosen t-SNE embedding are not independently verified physical modes.
Real-observation provenance remains unresolved; FITS header labels alone cannot establish it.

reproduction.runtime: Existing .venv-br030 NumPy and CPU PyTorch; no install. No torchkbnufft, ehtim or astropy available.

observations: 938 native u/v points and explicitly derived conjugates reveal sparse Fourier coverage; 465 closure phases and 485 log closure amplitudes retain source row order.
Retained Gaussian helper, supplied reference and saved mean share 0..0.0362861 Jy/pixel scaling. The current prior differs in flux and must be labeled separately in the story.
First six stored posterior images are displayed without score-based selection and on the same reference-peak intensity scale. They are sample indices, not a time sequence.
Population std uses its own full numeric scale. The binary containment panel shows 180/1024 reference pixels satisfying absolute error <= std. This is not repeated-data calibration.
Frames are local inspection artifacts; labels, legends, interactions, reveal and mobile/export review still require canonical authoring.

findings: Verified 14 task sources, 60 shared source files, three upstream DPI sources and 28 assets at pinned revisions. The complete HF listing has 30 files: two .pt checkpoints were deliberately not fetched. Extra data/meta_data is byte-identical to data/meta_data.json. Object-valued loss_history.npy was not deserialized.

The 938 stored complex visibilities cover nine stations and 100 timestamps. Source closure indices reproduce all 465 closure phases modulo 360 degrees within 4.53e-11 degrees and all 485 log closure amplitudes exactly. All ten closure index/sign arrays match both retained fixture versions.

The source uses log|V12| + log|V34| - log|V14| - log|V23| for the supplied quadrangle station ordering. Its README writes a different denominator pairing. The explanation must follow the verified array/code convention.

Deterministic multiplicative station gains change native visibilities while preserving closure phases and log-amplitude ratios to floating-point precision. This bounded arithmetic identity does not cancel thermal noise or establish independence of closure rows.

Five data-loss fixtures, four prior-loss outputs and both metric fixtures replay using selected pure functions on existing CPU PyTorch. The current Fourier trajectory and pulse match retained fixtures within float precision. The fixture generator source omits the phase factor, so its current text does not establish fixture reproducibility. No NUFFT model is executed.

Current build_prior_image uses median absolute visibility over all 938 baselines, giving 0.2738309775 Jy. Retained fixtures and the pinned upstream notebook use the 68 APEX-ALMA measurements, giving 2.0444813540 Jy. The retained prior sum includes a 1e-6 floor; source prior and retained prior must not be conflated.

Saved posterior_mean.npy and posterior_std.npy exactly equal population mean/std of the 1024 images in posterior_samples.npy. posterior_samples_1024.npy contains a different 1024-image set: its mean differs by up to 0.012808895 Jy/pixel. No new images, fitted clustering or posterior modes were generated.

Task-native saved mean metrics reproduce source metadata: NCC 0.6564992992, NRMSE 0.1344757986, mean std 0.00107326696 Jy/pixel. Exactly 180/1024 reference pixels lie within mean plus or minus one std. This descriptive spatial containment is not frequentist calibration or a universal Gaussian 68-percent test.

The source flux_relative_error=0.0004 matches comparison to the retained 2.0444813540 Jy prior target; the saved mean is about 8.04 percent above supplied reference flux 1.89158309 Jy. Retain the original score with its actual denominator.

Local filesystem end-to-end dispatch uses the generic scorer: raw-intensity range NRMSE 0.090637 and cosine NCC 0.714299. The task-native helper peak-normalizes and uses centered correlation. Absent, zero or exaggerated std leaves the generic image score unchanged; a sample stack is rejected. Published metrics provide no thresholds, so passed is null.

The legacy no-filesystem-workspace scorer uses a different flux-normalized relative-L2 NRMSE. Its source was inspected but that fallback was not executed; local filesystem scoring controls do not establish Docker equivalence.

All L1-L3 seed the entire data directory, including ground_truth.npz and gt.fits. Source/evaluation directories are not seeded. Staging commands were intercepted without installation or agent execution; a reader reveal cannot establish private reference access.

Pinned main.py is syntactically invalid at line24. The current loader returns 20 array fields, but DPISolver.reconstruct requires obs_data["obs"] at line444. These are retained source defects; no repair or rerun of scientific output is implied.

The gt.fits and obs.uvfits Git blobs exactly match HeSunPU/DPI dataset/interferometry1 at pinned upstream commit 1bf3f02a92796af737bd6fe6233d1d0dd778ffd5. Headers identify SgrA and a 2015 date, while the DPI paper separates synthetic Sgr A* examples from real EHT 2017 M87 data. The task README real-observation claim remains unverified; do not describe supplied ground truth as an observed black-hole image.

Native Fourier views, gain cancellation, retained priors, stored sample diversity, mean/std/error and scorer controls can support an operation-specific story. No canonical export or visual acceptance is claimed at this checkpoint.
